basic_profile.bio: I'm a 24-year-old hobbyist from Portland, Oregon, diving into the world of 3D printing. I've always had a knack for DIY projects and tech, which led me to purchase an Ender 3 Pro. Outside of printing, I'm an avid gamer and love streaming my gameplay on Twitch. I'm single and usually online during the evenings and weekends. I work as a junior graphic designer for a small startup, and I enjoy blending technology with creativity. Still learning the ropes of Reddit, but I'm eager to connect with others who share my interests.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in graphic design, which has helped me understand the basics of 3D modeling. Most of my knowledge comes from online tutorials and forums, as well as trial and error with my 3D printer. I'm still relatively new to the printing community, but I'm keen to learn more from experienced users.
